mapper.sql: SELECT ri.id AS receipt_item_id, r.id AS receipt_id, r.receipt_no, r.purchase_order_id, ri.purchase_order_item_id, r.warehouse_id, r.supplier_id, r.supplier_name_snapshot, ri.sku_id, oi.product_name_snapshot, ri.purchase_unit_snapshot AS unit_snapshot, ri.received_quantity AS quantity, po.purchaser_id, latest.id AS previous_adjustment_id, COALESCE(latest.new_price, oi.purchase_price) AS previous_price FROM xsy_purchase_receipt_item ri JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt r ON r.id = ri.purchase_receipt_id AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND r.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_purchase_order po ON po.id = r.purchase_order_id AND po.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_purchase_order_item oi ON oi.id = ri.purchase_order_item_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.id, a.new_price FROM xsy_purchase_cost_adjustment a WHERE a.receipt_item_id = ri.id ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON TRUE WHERE ri.deleted = FALSE AND ri.received_quantity > 0
mapper.select: AND r.purchase_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY r.id, ri.id
SELECT a.*, r.receipt_no FROM xsy_purchase_cost_adjustment a JOIN xsy_purchase_receipt r ON r.id = a.receipt_id WHERE a.purchase_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY a.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_purchase_cost_adjustment(adjustment_no, receipt_item_id, receipt_id, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_item_id, warehouse_id, supplier_id, supplier_name_snapshot, sku_id, product_name_snapshot, unit_snapshot, quantity, previous_adjustment_id, previous_price, new_price, direction, amount, reason, occurred_at, created_by) VALUES (#{adjustmentNo}, #{receiptItemId}, #{receiptId}, #{purchaseOrderId}, #{purchaseOrderItemId}, #{warehouseId}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierNameSnapshot}, #{skuId}, #{productNameSnapshot}, #{unitSnapshot}, #{quantity}, #{previousAdjustmentId}, #{previousPrice}, #{newPrice}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{occurredAt}, #{createdBy})
